data.long_meaning: Ananthan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Ananta', meaning infinite or endless. In Hindu mythology, Anantha is a serpent who supports the universe and is symbolic of infinite existence. The name Ananthan is thus bestowed upon children to signify their limitless potential and infinite growth. The name Ananthan carries the meaning “Endless, Infinite” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ananthan usually hope their child will grow to embody endless, infinite and live with faith, good character and purpose.
